newsitem.title: USA: EDS wins $42 mln contract from U.S. Post.
newsitem.headline: EDS wins $42 mln contract from U.S. Post.

text.p: EDS Corp has won a $42-million contract to help the U.S. Postal Service manage and monitor its computer technology in more than 7,000 offices across the country, the company said Friday.

EDS said the value of the cost-plus-fee contract is $42 million for the first three years with four two-year options to be negotiated on a fixed-price basis. The estimated value of the entire contract is about $200 million, it added.
The company said it will create an operational system in Raleigh, N.C., creating more than 400 local jobs by the third year of the 11-year agreement.
It said it will provide a variety of services, including customer help desk support, configuration and security management, and remote database monitoring and management.
